# Getting help

GitHub shows this page when you open a new issue. Most questions have a faster answer than waiting for a reply.

## Setting it up

The [README](../README.md#install) covers installing through the Marketplace and the card's options.

## The grid stays empty

The card draws long-term statistics, which Home Assistant only keeps for a sensor with a state class. A new sensor gets its first day within the hour, and the grid starts on the day the sensor was added. With Life Dashboard, earlier days need **Send history** in the phone app; screen time only goes back about a week.

## Still stuck, or want to ask something

[Discussions](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-ha/discussions) of the integration is the place for questions, setup help and ideas. No GitHub account? The [feedback board](https://owen282000.com/life-dashboard/feedback/) needs none. Everything on it is public, so leave out health data, logs and webhook URLs.

## Reporting a bug

If something is genuinely broken, open an [issue](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-year-card/issues/new/choose).

Security problems go through [private advisories](https://github.com/owen282000/life-dashboard-year-card/security/advisories/new), not public issues.
